detail.longDescription: It's official. Bloom (previously Grove) is now available on Google Play Store. Thank you so much for the support you have shown that has helped me improve the app. Go to the following link to install the app from Play Store. https:// play.google.com/store/apps/det ails?id=com.rrajath.grove Here's the GitHub page for the app: https:// github.com/rrajath/bloom # emacs # orgmode # productivity # apps
